title: Alliterative Vocabulary
subtitle: Five synonyms for 'man' in fifty lines.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Gawain's poet loves rare and archaic words (burne = man, lede = man, hathel = hero, renk = man, tulk = man). Five synonyms for 'man' in fifty lines. The lexical richness of the alliterative tradition. This is not Chaucer's vocabulary; this is the older, northern poetic register.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Alliterative Vocabulary.
